item.title: Pick Your Theme
item.dc:creator: Luis Majano
item.description: Update: this post originally covered the three themes BxSites launched with. The lineup has since grown into a full ten-theme gallery - the table and advice below now cover all ten. One question I get a lot after someone runs bxSites new for the first time: "which theme should I actually pick?" The honest answer is that it barely matters at the feature level - all ten built-in themes ship the exact same set of capabilities. It's purely a question of which one matches your project's own visual identity.
